hooks.command: "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python" -B "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/commitvakt.py" || { [ -z "$NWP_COMMIT_TILLATET" ] || { echo 'commitvakten nekade eller kunde inte köras' >&2; exit 2; }; }

"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python" -B "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/stoppvakt.py" || { [ -z "$NWP_SLUG" ] || { echo 'stoppvakten kunde inte köras eller blockerade; se meddelandet ovan, eller kör .venv/bin/python kontroller/prova.py <slug>' >&2; exit 2; }; }
